DIVINER-BALANCE.title: Balance
DIVINER-BALANCE.description: Good Omen: lose 1 Destiny, Divinate, and draw !Cards! card. Bad Omen: this costs 2 extra Energy, then gain 1 Destiny.
DIVINER-BAD_FEELING.title: Bad Feeling
DIVINER-BAD_FEELING.description: Apply 1 Weak. Bad Omen: apply 1 Weak and 1 Vulnerable instead.
DIVINER-BAD_FEELING.upgradedDesc: Bad Omen: apply 1 Weak and 1 Vulnerable to all enemies instead.
DIVINER-CROSSED_LINES.title: Crossed Lines
DIVINER-CROSSED_LINES.description: Deal !Damage! damage. If you have Divinated this run, apply 1 Weak.
DIVINER-CROSSED_LINES.upgradedDesc: Deal !Damage! damage. If you have Divinated this run, apply 2 Weak.
DIVINER-DESTINED_LANCE.title: Destined Lance
DIVINER-DESTINED_LANCE.description: Deal !Damage! damage. Good Omen: hit all enemies.
DIVINER-DESTINY_FALL.title: Destiny's Fall
DIVINER-DESTINY_FALL.description: Deal !Damage! damage. Foretell: Deal 8 damage to the same enemy.
DIVINER-DESTINY_FALL.upgradedDesc: Deal !Damage! damage. Foretell: Deal 10 damage to the same enemy.
DIVINER-ECLIPSE_JAB.title: Eclipse Jab
DIVINER-FALSE_ALARM.title: False Alarm
DIVINER-FOREWARNED_BLOW.title: Forewarned Blow
DIVINER-FOREWARNED_BLOW.description: Deal !Damage! damage. If the target has Weak, draw !Cards! card.
DIVINER-FOREWARNED_BLOW.upgradedDesc: Deal !Damage! damage. If the target has Weak, draw !Cards! cards.
DIVINER-INSURANCE.title: Insurance
DIVINER-INSURANCE.description: Gain !Block! Block. Whenever you lose HP this turn, draw !Cards! card.
DIVINER-LINE_OF_FATE.title: Line of Fate
DIVINER-LUCKY_BREAK.title: Lucky Break
DIVINER-MARK_CALENDAR.title: Omen of Shelter
DIVINER-MISREAD_STRIKE.title: Misread Strike
DIVINER-NARROW_ESCAPE.title: Narrow Escape
DIVINER-NARROW_ESCAPE.description: Gain !Block! Block. Doomed: gain 1 Countdown of Destiny.
DIVINER-OMENS_ALIGN.title: Omens Align
DIVINER-OMENS_ALIGN.description: Put all Fortune and Misfortune cards into your hand.
DIVINER-OMENS_ALIGN.upgradedDesc: Put all Fortune and Misfortune cards into your hand.
DIVINER-PALM_READING.title: Palm Reading
DIVINER-PALM_READING.description: Scry 4. If you divinated this combat, draw !Cards! card.
DIVINER-PALM_READING.upgradedDesc: Scry 6. If you divinated this combat, draw !Cards! card.
DIVINER-PALM_STRIKE.title: Palm Strike
DIVINER-PALM_STRIKE.description: Deal !Damage! damage. Good Omen: draw !Cards! cards.
DIVINER-READ_THE_ROOM.title: Read the Room
DIVINER-RECONSULT.title: Reconsult
DIVINER-RECONSULT.description: If you have divinated this combat, Divinate.
DIVINER-SKEPTICS_CHARM.title: Skeptic's Charm
DIVINER-SKEPTICS_CHARM.description: Gain !Block! Block. Bad Omen: gain 6 more Block.
DIVINER-SKEPTICS_CHARM.upgradedDesc: Gain !Block! Block. Bad Omen: gain 8 more Block.
DIVINER-SMALL_RITUAL.title: Small Ritual
DIVINER-SMALL_RITUAL.description: The next time you Divinate, gain [E] [E].
DIVINER-SMALL_RITUAL.upgradedDesc: The next time you Divinate, gain [E] [E] [E].
DIVINER-SMOKE_AND_MIRRORS.title: Smoke and Mirrors
DIVINER-SMOKE_AND_MIRRORS.description: Gain !Block! Block. The next Foretell effect you play this combat resolves with +5 damage or +5 Block.
DIVINER-SMOKE_AND_MIRRORS.upgradedDesc: Gain !Block! Block. The next Foretell effect you play this combat resolves with +9 damage or +9 Block.
DIVINER-TEA_LEAVES.title: Omen of Insight
DIVINER-THREAD_CUT.title: Thread Cut
DIVINER-THREAD_CUT.description: Deal !Damage! damage. If the target has Weak, deal 10 more.
DIVINER-THREAD_CUT.upgradedDesc: Deal !Damage! damage. If the target has Weak, deal 14 more.
DIVINER-THREAD_PULL.title: Thread Pull
DIVINER-THREAD_PULL.description: Put a card from your hand on top of your draw pile. Foretell: draw !Cards! cards.
DIVINER-THREAD_PULL.selectPrompt: Choose a card to put on top of your draw pile.
DIVINER-WARD_SIGN.title: Ward Sign
DIVINER-WARD_SIGN.description: Gain !Block! Block. Good Omen: Retain a card in your hand this turn.
DIVINER-WARD_SIGN.selectPrompt: Choose a card to Retain this turn.
DIVINER-WAX_SEAL.title: Wax Seal
DIVINER-WAX_SEAL.description: Deal !Damage! damage. Put a card from your draw or discard pile on top of your draw pile.
DIVINER-WAX_SEAL.selectPrompt: Choose a card to put on top of your draw pile.
DIVINER-DEFEND_DIVINER.title: Defend
DIVINER-DIVINATION_OF_WOES.title: Omen of Woes
DIVINER-DIVINATION_OF_WOES.description: Foretell: Deal !Damage! damage and apply 1 Weak and 1 Vulnerable to all enemies.
DIVINER-ESCAPE_FROM_DESTINY.title: Escape from Destiny
DIVINER-ESCAPE_FROM_DESTINY.description: Doomed only. Gain 1 Countdown of Destiny. Escape from Destiny costs 1 more this combat.
DIVINER-FORTUNE.title: Fortune
DIVINER-MISFORTUNE.title: Misfortune
DIVINER-MISFORTUNE.description: Deal !Damage! damage to all enemies. At end of turn, lose 5 HP and trigger this effect.
DIVINER-CLAIRVOYANCE.title: Clairvoyance
DIVINER-CLAIRVOYANCE.description: Search your draw pile for 1 card. Put it into your hand; it is Fated.
DIVINER-CLAIRVOYANCE.selectPrompt: Choose a card to put into your hand.
DIVINER-APOCALYPSE.title: Apocalypse
DIVINER-APOCALYPSE.description: Deal !Damage! damage to all enemies. Set Destiny to 0. Doomed: costs 3 less.
DIVINER-FALLEN_SKY.title: Fallen Sky
DIVINER-FALLEN_SKY.description: Deal !Damage! damage to all enemies. Foretell: play this card again.
DIVINER-HAND_OF_FATE.title: Hand of Fate
DIVINER-HAND_OF_FATE.description: Deal !Damage! damage. Draw !Cards! card. Revelation: play this 3 times.
DIVINER-THE_LAST_WORD.title: The Last Word
DIVINER-THE_LAST_WORD.description: Deal !Damage! damage. If Fatal, gain 1 Destiny.
DIVINER-UNAVOIDABLE_END.title: Unavoidable End
DIVINER-UNAVOIDABLE_END.description: Deal !Damage! damage. Foretell: deal double that damage to all enemies.
DIVINER-GREATER_PORTENT.title: Greater Portent
DIVINER-GREATER_PORTENT.description: Search 3 cards from your draw pile. Put them into your hand; they are Fated.
DIVINER-GREATER_PORTENT.selectPrompt: Choose cards to put into your hand.
DIVINER-REVERSAL.title: Reversal
DIVINER-REVERSAL.description: Set Destiny to 5 minus its current value.
DIVINER-ORACLES_BARGAIN.title: Oracle's Bargain
DIVINER-ORACLES_BARGAIN.description: Gain 1 Destiny and add 3 Misfortunes to your draw pile.
DIVINER-PERFECT_FORECAST.title: Perfect Forecast
DIVINER-PERFECT_FORECAST.description: Divinate twice. Gain [E] for each unique category ever recorded.
DIVINER-CHEAT_THE_ENDING.title: Cheat the Ending
DIVINER-CHEAT_THE_ENDING.description: The next time you would die this combat, heal to 13 and set Destiny to 0.
DIVINER-FIXED_POINT.title: Fixed Point
DIVINER-FIXED_POINT.description: Destiny cannot decrease below 3 this combat. At the start of your turn, lose 1 HP.
DIVINER-MANY_FUTURES.title: Many Futures
DIVINER-MANY_FUTURES.description: Card rewards at the end of this combat have 1 additional option. When you Scry, choose 1 additional card.
DIVINER-DOOM_SPIRAL.title: Doom Spiral
DIVINER-DOOM_SPIRAL.description: At end of turn, if Bad Omen, add a Misfortune to your hand.
DIVINER-ECHOED_OMEN.title: Echoed Omen
DIVINER-ECHOED_OMEN.description: Foretell effects trigger an additional time.
DIVINER-BREAK_THE_SEQUENCE.title: Break the Sequence
DIVINER-BREAK_THE_SEQUENCE.description: Scry 8. Revelation: if you have an active relic divination, choose up to 1 foretold relic and remove it from the relic sequence.
DIVINER-BREAK_THE_SEQUENCE.upgradedDesc: Scry 10. Revelation: if you have an active relic divination, choose up to 1 foretold relic and remove it from the relic sequence.
DIVINER-ASCENDED_FORM.title: Ascended Form
DIVINER-ASCENDED_FORM.description: Revelation card effects can be triggered with 2 less Destiny.
DIVINER-ASCENDED_FORM.upgradedDesc: Revelation card effects can be triggered with 3 less Destiny.
DIVINER-STRIKE_DIVINER.title: Strike
DIVINER-STAR_NEEDLE.title: Star Needle
DIVINER-STAR_NEEDLE.description: Deal !Damage! damage. If you have 7 or more recorded divinations, apply 7 Vulnerable.
DIVINER-DOOMSCRIPT.title: Doomscript
DIVINER-DOOMSCRIPT.description: Deal !Damage! damage. Foretell: apply 2 Vulnerable to all enemies.
DIVINER-DOOMSCRIPT.upgradedDesc: Deal !Damage! damage. Foretell: apply 3 Vulnerable to all enemies.
DIVINER-HOROSCOPE.title: Horoscope
DIVINER-HOROSCOPE.description: Deal !Damage! damage. If the top card of your draw pile is an Attack, draw it.
DIVINER-RED_THREAD.title: Red Thread
DIVINER-RED_THREAD.description: Deal !Damage! damage. Search your draw pile for an Attack and put it on top.
DIVINER-RED_THREAD.selectPrompt: Choose an Attack to put on top of your draw pile.
DIVINER-HEXAGRAM.title: Hexagram
DIVINER-HEXAGRAM.description: Deal !Damage! damage to a random enemy 6 times. Revelation: choose the target.
DIVINER-BACKDATED_WOUND.title: Backdated Wound
DIVINER-INEVITABILITY.title: Inevitability
DIVINER-INEVITABILITY.description: Deal !Damage! damage. Costs 1 less for every 2 recorded divinations.
DIVINER-CURSED_PREDICTION.title: Cursed Prediction
DIVINER-CURSED_PREDICTION.description: Deal !Damage! damage. Add a Misfortune to your discard pile.
DIVINER-CURSED_PREDICTION.upgradedDesc: Deal !Damage! damage. Add a Misfortune to your hand.
DIVINER-DEAD_STAR.title: Dead Star
DIVINER-DEAD_STAR.description: Deal !Damage! damage. Lose 1 HP. Bad Omen: deal !Damage! damage again.
DIVINER-DEAD_STAR.upgradedDesc: Deal !Damage! damage. Lose 1 HP. Bad Omen: deal !Damage! damage again.
DIVINER-VERDICT.title: Verdict
DIVINER-VERDICT.description: Deal !Damage! damage. If the target has Weak or Vulnerable, deal 12 instead.
DIVINER-VERDICT.upgradedDesc: Deal !Damage! damage. If the target has Weak or Vulnerable, deal 16 instead.
DIVINER-AUGURY.title: Augury
DIVINER-AUGURY.description: If you have divinated this combat, gain 1 Destiny. Otherwise gain !Block! Block.
DIVINER-SECOND_SIGHT.title: Second Sight
DIVINER-SECOND_SIGHT.description: Draw until you have 5 cards in hand.
DIVINER-SECOND_SIGHT.upgradedDesc: Draw until you have 6 cards in hand.
DIVINER-LOADED_READING.title: Loaded Reading
DIVINER-LOADED_READING.description: Add a Fortune and a Misfortune to your hand.
DIVINER-COLD_READING.title: Cold Reading
DIVINER-COLD_READING.description: Apply 2 Weak and 2 Vulnerable. If you divinated this combat, apply to all enemies.
DIVINER-COLD_READING.upgradedDesc: Apply 3 Weak and 3 Vulnerable. If you divinated this combat, apply to all enemies.
DIVINER-READ_AHEAD.title: Read Ahead
DIVINER-READ_AHEAD.description: Draw !Cards! cards. Put !Cards! cards from your hand on top of your draw pile.
DIVINER-READ_AHEAD.selectPrompt: Choose cards to put on top of your draw pile.
DIVINER-UNASKED_QUESTION.title: Unasked Question
DIVINER-REWRITE_THE_SIGN.title: Rewrite the Sign
DIVINER-REWRITE_THE_SIGN.description: Replace all Misfortunes in your hand, draw pile, and discard pile with Fortunes.
DIVINER-REWRITE_THE_SIGN.upgradedDesc: Replace all Misfortunes and Escapes from Destiny in your hand, draw pile, and discard pile with Fortunes.
DIVINER-PREDESTINED_PATH.title: Predestined Path
DIVINER-PREDESTINED_PATH.description: Choose 2 cards from your draw pile. Foretell: put them into your hand; they are Fated that turn.
DIVINER-PREDESTINED_PATH.selectPrompt: Choose cards to draw next turn.
DIVINER-EVIL_EYE.title: Evil Eye
DIVINER-READ_THE_ASHES.title: Read the Ashes
DIVINER-READ_THE_ASHES.description: Exhaust a card. Foretell: draw 1 card. If a Status or Curse is Exhausted, Foretell: gain [E] [E].
DIVINER-BORROWED_TOMORROW.title: Borrowed Tomorrow
DIVINER-FUNERAL_CLOCK.title: Funeral Clock
DIVINER-FUNERAL_CLOCK.description: Gain !Block! Block. Doomed: costs 1 less; gain 1 Countdown of Destiny and draw !Cards! card.
DIVINER-WHITE_ROOM.title: White Room
DIVINER-WHITE_ROOM.description: Draw !Cards! cards. Revelation: choose up to 2 cards in your hand. They are Fated.
DIVINER-WHITE_ROOM.upgradedDesc: Draw !Cards! cards. Revelation: choose up to 3 cards in your hand. They are Fated.
DIVINER-PROPHETIC_TRANCE.title: Prophetic Trance
DIVINER-PROPHETIC_TRANCE.description: Innate. Whenever you Divinate, draw 2 cards.
DIVINER-THE_WRITTEN_HOUR.title: The Written Hour
DIVINER-THE_WRITTEN_HOUR.description: At the start of your turn, if Destiny is exactly 3, gain [E] and draw 1 card.
DIVINER-PATTERN_RECOGNITION.title: Pattern Recognition
DIVINER-PATTERN_RECOGNITION.description: Whenever you play the third card in a turn, Good Omen: gain 3 Block. Bad Omen: deal 3 damage to all enemies.
DIVINER-PATTERN_RECOGNITION.upgradedDesc: Whenever you play the third card in a turn, Good Omen: gain 4 Block. Bad Omen: deal 4 damage to all enemies.
DIVINER-HARUSPEX_METHOD.title: Haruspex Method
DIVINER-HARUSPEX_METHOD.description: The next time you Exhaust a card, Divinate and Foretell: add a Haruspex Method to your hand.
DIVINER-CHOSEN_LINE.title: Chosen Line
DIVINER-CHOSEN_LINE.description: Only playable if Revelation. The first card you draw each turn is Fated. Draw 1 extra card per turn.
DIVINER-DOOM_ENGINE.title: Doom Engine
DIVINER-DOOM_ENGINE.description: Misfortunes HP lost reduced by 1 and deal 9 more damage. Add a Misfortune to your hand.
DIVINER-DOOM_ENGINE.upgradedDesc: Misfortunes HP lost reduced by 2 and deal 13 more damage. Add a Misfortune to your hand.
DIVINER-LEDGER_OF_SIGNS.title: Ledger of Signs
DIVINER-LEDGER_OF_SIGNS.description: Every 3 times you Foretell, add a Fortune to your hand.
